author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect).** New migration 16: upstream_labelers + upstream_labeler_keys (pubkey cache with TTL). New polaris-backend/src/ingest/upstream_labels.rs with UpstreamLabelerConsumer per-upstream task. Reconnect with exponential backoff + jitter. Signature verification via proto_blue_crypto::K256Verifier — unsigned/wrong-sig labels dropped with tracing::warn!. Trust weight: weights JSONB keyed by label_value → f32 (default 0.5). Observation::ExternalLabel insert via existing repo; trigger refreshes risk_signals. Cursor persists per-upstream so reconnect resumes without loss. Wire-level reconnect-with-loss integration test deferred to #51.
